wins: Maintained consistent reconnaissance pacing to accumulate a total reward of 60 despite repeated mentor interventions.
Identified initial foothold artifacts quickly enough to capture early indicators, suggesting solid scanning procedures.
fails: Primary objective never achieved (0% success rate) due to inability to progress beyond initial access, triggering 10 mentor calls.
Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly stalled because credential validation was not confirmed before exploiting services.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was steady and well-paced, but inability to validate credentials and move past initial access prevented mission success; needs focused escalation strategy.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation stalls because credentials were not confirmed before attempting service exploits.

skill_cards.then_action: Execute credential validation via su/sudo checks before escalating
